decision: A valid strategy failure or materially poor performance closes the current hypothesis version and triggers a bounded GPT Deep Research failure-feedback cycle.
browser_contract: GPT-5.6 Sol -> Pro -> + -> Nghiên cứu sâu with UI readback before submission
guardrails: Invalid runs route to correctness or infrastructure repair, not strategy conclusions.
The failed hypothesis remains killed or parked and cannot be post-hoc rescued.
GPT output is research input only and may return NO LEGAL CANDIDATE or BLOCKED_BY_DATA.
Every new independent or child hypothesis requires source audit, registry de-duplication, a cheap offline probe, a new ID, and a frozen preregistration.
An exposed holdout is not recycled and an unchanged blocker or duplicate family stops the loop.
